game.name: Bureau : XCOM Declassified, The (Germany)
game.desc: The Bureau: XCOM Declassified is a tactical TPS for Xbox 360. It tells the story of the mysterious beginnings of XCOM, a para-governmental organisation that was supposed to face a communist invasion. As Special Agent William Carter, the player must take command and lead his teams of agents in a war against not the communists, but the aliens who have invaded the planet.
